subject: S18: retention for new tables + SW/CSP needs
body: New tables in S18 migration 0023: sync_ops (idempotency cache, keep 24 h, created_at index) and sync_tombstones (keep 90 days, created_at index). Please cover them in naadi.prune.daily (or tell me to add naadi_api/sync/gc.py::prune(conn) and you call it). New S18 routes all carry a limiter dep. Service worker (vite-plugin-pwa injectManifest, /sw.js at the root): needs 'worker-src self' (or script-src self fallback) and the SW fetches content-public figures from the Supabase Storage origin (already in img-src; the SW's fetch also needs that origin in connect-src). No inline scripts; the registration is a module import. No new third-party hosts.
